name: PLATO Convex Discrete QPLIB Benchmark
description: Benchmarks mixed-integer QP solvers on 31 convex discrete QP instances from QPLIB where the objective is convex quadratic and variables include integers, requiring proof of global optimality within a 2-hour time limit. The convex objective simplifies the continuous relaxations but integrality still makes the problem NP-hard. Compares specialised MIQP solvers and general MINLP solvers.
domain: optimization, mixed-integer quadratic programming, operations research
typical_sota_score: SHOT (1.02s mean, 25/31); COPT (1.0s mean, 24/31). 2-hour time limit. SCIP and MINOTAUR single-threaded.
reputation: Specialist MIQP benchmark; maintained by Hans Mittelmann at ASU.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Problems from QPLIB IDs 3547–10069. Hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X (12 cores, 128GB). Global optimality required (mipgap=zero).
